decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album 'Fear No Evil'. The source documents reveal two distinct albums with this title: 1) 'Fear No Evil (Doro album)' by the German singer Doro (Source D1S1). 2) 'Fear No Evil (Slaughter album)' by the American band Slaughter (Source D4S1). Both are valid answers representing distinct entities. Source D2S2 claims the album is credited to Ozzy Osbourne, but this contradicts the explicit disambiguation in D1S1 and D4S1 which attribute the specific albums to Doro and Slaughter respectively. The claim in D2S2 appears to be an error or hallucination within the provided text, as no other source supports Ozzy Osbourne as the artist of an album titled 'Fear No Evil', and it conflicts with the clear entity definitions in D1 and D4. Therefore, only Doro and Slaughter are retained as valid, distinct answers.
